what: blaze_query::db panics after 2^28 writes: Storage::next_view asserts view < VIEW_MASK (row.rs:46, 28 bits), storage.rs:351 "the query database ran out of views (268435455)". round3b-bench.log: db/verify/deep_unrelated (one write + one fetch an iteration, ~30 ns) spent all 2^28 views inside tango 8 s budget. A daemon lives for days and every input set opens a view, so this is a real limit, not a bench artifact: renumber views when the counter nears the top (with &mut, no readers: map every row verified word and color to a compacted view, or reset to view 1 with every row marked verified-before-1 so it verifies by summary/walk) or widen the field, and add a test that crosses the limit. The bench now rebuilds its database every 2^24 writes (query_hit.rs REBUILD) so it can measure; drop that once this is fixed.
